name: Lamb Koftas with Herby Couscous
method: Mix the lamb with the grated onion, cumin and smoked paprika and shape into 8 koftas. Fry or grill for 10–12 minutes, turning.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff up with the oil.
Stir the chopped cucumber and tomatoes through the couscous and serve the koftas with the Greek yogurt.
